"commit 0f47b1240c739fefb0472e4f73ac71a2c8b6d927\n"
"Author:     Xubqpanda <1227972384@qq.com>\n"
"AuthorDate: Thu Oct 8 15:02:32 2026 +0800\n"
"Commit:     Xubqpanda <1227972384@qq.com>\n"
"CommitDate: Thu Oct 8 15:02:32 2026 +0800\n"
"\n"
"    data: Reasoning Gym and 2WikiMultihopQA, and the three forms of the official-scorer gate\n"
"    \n"
"    - Gate 3 has three admissible forms and these two rounds are the new ones. Reasoning Gym's\n"
"      metric **is** the upstream package's function (`Dataset.score_answer(answer, entry)`), so\n"
"      the faithful port is a **call**: the test compares `score()` against the library called\n"
"      independently, and the pins move to the version (`reasoning-gym==0.1.25`), the seed and a\n"
"      materialized pool. 2WikiMultihopQA's metric is a **column of a published table** -- its\n"
"      leaderboard prints Ans/Sup/Evi/Joint separately -- so Ans F1 is reported under its own\n"
"      name, and Sup/Evi/Joint are transcribed, runnable and named as missing. The third form is\n"
"      the refusal this repository already had: HotpotQA's leaderboard number is `joint`.\n"
"    - 89 of Reasoning Gym's 106 families are usable, and the rule that chose them is gate 2\n"
"      itself: reference answer to 1.0 **and** empty answer to 0.0. A family whose scorer accepts\n"
"      an empty answer would hand the do-nothing control reward. `composite` raises without a\n"
"      nested config. The list is written out, and every admitted family is re-checked against the\n"
"      pin, so a release that changes one fails loudly.\n"
"    - 2Wiki's whole evaluator is transcribed **verbatim as a substring** of the adapter\n"
"      (`count(region) == 1`, so a one-character edit fails), and the test then runs the\n"
"      *unmodified upstream program* as a subprocess on the same rows and predictions and requires\n"
"      the two aggregates to be equal. Measured on 500 rows: em 55.8, f1 68.18 -- and 68.67 with\n"
"      the article/lowercase order swapped, which is why the test runs upstream and not a\n"
"      paraphrase.\n"
"    - The alias channel is part of the metric: `{answer} | aliases[answer_id]`, on 10,603 of the\n"
"      12,576 rows, every id resolving, worth 0.64 Ans F1. Every parquet conversion of this\n"
"      dataset ships the answer column and not the ids, so the convenient mirror was the wrong\n"
"      pool; identity rests on a second independent mirror agreeing on all 12,576 rows, which is\n"
"      a test rather than a sentence in a docstring.\n"
"    - A generated pool is not a download: declaring one as a synthetic `http` entry is refused by\n"
"      the lint, and a `provision_status()` inherited from `QASpec` reports `SKIP` for a generated\n"
"      table -- a failure for a published dataset, and two gates were not running until it was\n"
"      overridden. A pool row also must not carry an id it does not own: the pool's `task_id`\n"
"      disagreed with the platform's and cost a `KeyError` in a test that never looked at ids.\n"
"    - `tools/dataset_classes.py` needs a dataset in **both** maps. The `EXPECTED_INTERACTION`\n"
"      entry missed for reasoning_gym surfaced one dataset later, while classifying\n"
"      twowikimultihopqa. Both are `single_shot` / `information_seeking`.\n"
"    - Docs: skill doc rounds 23-24, the three forms of gate 3 on the procedure page, the QA\n"
"      scaffold list, and `DOWNLOADS.md`.\n"
"    \n"
"    Measured: reasoning_gym `load()` 0.31 s for 1,780 tasks; twowikimultihopqa 1.68 s cold for\n"
"    12,576; gates 1-2 pass by hand and through `--platform` for both; the full quality suite is\n"
"    1294 passed, 2 skipped, 1 deselected (the known parallel-tasks flake).\n"
